title: Korean Pear Marinade
headnote: Scaled for 2.2 lb (998 g) of beef or other meat. Adapted from the four-pear house marinade, using agave.

ingredientGroups.title: Marinade
items: 155 g Korean (Asian) pear, peeled and cored
78 g Sempio Jin Gold S soy sauce

steps: Peel and core the pear; cut the pear, onion, garlic, and ginger into pieces suitable for blending.
Blend the pear, soy sauce, brown sugar, agave, sesame oil, garlic, ginger, onion, rice vinegar, and black pepper until smooth.
Stir in sesame seeds and sliced scallions. For a spicy version, blend in gochujang and gochugaru.
Coat 2.2 lb (998 g) of meat evenly with the marinade. Refrigerate while marinating, ideally 4–8 hours for sliced beef; avoid extended marinating for very thin cuts.
Remove excess marinade before searing or grilling to limit burning from the sugars. Cook the meat to its appropriate safe temperature; discard marinade that touched raw meat unless boiled before use.
